nodes.name: Start
A retail bank receives a service request
customer submits the initial information
The service desk registers and validates the case
If the case is incomplete, the team requests missing information and waits for a corrected resubmission before validating again
If it is eligible, business review and system verification happen in parallel
If both approve, the service desk notifies the requester
If either rejects, the team records an exception, then notifies the requester
End
